1.consolidated_definition: Indica que no siempre recibe el beneficio quien lo merece, sino quien menos esfuerzo realizó por ello.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Indicates that the benefit is not always received by those who deserve it, but rather by those who exerted the least effort to achieve it.
